effect_description_eng:
＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may trash up to 3 cards from your hand. To 1 of your opponent's Digimon, give -2000 DP for the turn for each card this effect trashed. Then, return 1 of their Digimon with 5000 DP or less to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon suspends, by returning 3 cards with [Jellymon] in their texts or the [DS] trait from your trash to the bottom of the deck, this Digimon may unsuspend.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Jellymon] in text or w/[DS] trait: Cost 3
